home.pillText: Local outreach, anywhere in the world
home.title: Reach thousands of <hl>local</hl> businesses, automatically.
home.subtitle: Prospectigo finds businesses on Google Maps, locates their contact form and drops your message in it. You pick the area and the trade, Prospectigo handles the rest.
home.howSubtitle: Three steps, and your outreach runs on its own.
home.step1: A city and its surroundings, a list of cities or a whole country. Then the trades you care about: restaurants, plumbers, real-estate agencies…
home.step2: It reads Google Maps, visits every website, finds the contact form and the e-mail address. Chains and listings without a website can be skipped.
home.step3: Your personalised message is dropped into every form, at your pace, with a screenshot as proof.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to prospect at scale
home.featuresSubtitle: No lists to buy, no copy-paste, no mailbox to connect.
home.feature1: Every business in an area, with its website, phone, rating and review count.
home.feature2: Prospectigo finds the contact form, even behind a button or a cookie banner, and fills it like a human would.
home.feature3: Up to four message variants, with the company name, city or trade inserted automatically.
home.feature4: Every prepared form can be reviewed before sending, with a screenshot. Business and Scale plans can validate automatically.
home.feature5: A different sender per campaign when needed, invite your team, export prospects as CSV.
home.feature6: When a website shows a contact address, Prospectigo collects it for your follow-ups.
home.controlTitle: You see everything, you decide everything.
home.controlText: Before each send, Prospectigo shows you the filled form. You approve, skip, or let automatic validation do the work. The daily send limit is set per campaign.
home.pricingSubtitle: Growth for a single business, Business and Scale for agencies.
home.pricingNote1: In most campaigns, each business found on Google Maps costs 1 prospecting credit, and each form sent costs 1 outreach credit.
home.pricingNote2Label: Hard campaigns: 2 to 4 credits per prospect
home.pricingNote2: When your filters keep only a small share of businesses (for example "rating between 0.7 and 3.8"), Prospectigo has to go through many more listings to find each prospect. These campaigns cost 2, 3 or 4 prospecting credits per prospect. The rate is computed by the estimate, shown before launch and never changes afterwards.
home.pricingNote3: Your credits are used at the pace you choose, campaign by campaign. They renew every month. On the yearly plan you pay 10 months for 12.
home.pricingNote4: Plans are billed in USD, by card, with no commitment. Change plans or cancel anytime from your billing settings.

faqItems.q1: Which countries does Prospectigo work in?
faqItems.a1: Anywhere Google Maps lists businesses. France and the United States are the most tested; other countries are covered as standard.
faqItems.a2: Through the contact form on the business's website, filled in by Prospectigo. Nothing leaves your mailbox. When an e-mail address is found on the site, it is shown to you as well.
faqItems.q3: What are prospecting and outreach credits?
faqItems.a3: A prospecting credit is used for each business found on Google Maps (2 to 4 credits for hard campaigns, see the next question). An outreach credit is counted when a form has been sent successfully. Both renew every month with your plan, with no daily cap.
faqItems.q4: Why do some campaigns cost several credits per prospect?
faqItems.a4: Because they take Prospectigo much more work. Before launch, the estimate measures the share of businesses that pass your filters. If at least 10% pass, each prospect costs 1 credit. Between 3 and 10%, 2 credits. Between 1 and 3%, 3 credits. Below 1%, 4 credits. This rate is shown in the Find tab before you launch, then frozen for the life of the campaign.
faqItems.q5: Can I review messages before they go out?
faqItems.a5: Yes. Every prepared form is shown with a screenshot. You approve or skip. On Business and Scale plans you can turn on automatic validation per campaign.
faqItems.q6: I run an agency, can I manage several clients?
faqItems.a6: Yes. Add one sender per client and pick it in each campaign. Invite teammates up to your plan's seat count.
faqItems.a7: No. Plans are monthly or yearly and can be cancelled anytime from your billing settings.
